_comment: devourer radio, CRAFT side (§3.0): single 8812EU/AU adapter, role tx — video TX + return RX timeshared on one radio at 20 MHz (§1). RTP in from the local encoder on :5600. quiet_gap paces the §7.2 listen window after each END_OF_BLOCK (seeds; re-derive at gate 4). bus is the lsusb -t style path 'bus-port[.port]'; empty = first unclaimed Realtek device. power_map is the adapter's PHY_REG_PG.txt-format absolute table (§10.2).

streams._comment: Opus/RTP audio from the local encoder (waybeam_venc outgoing.audioPort, default 5601), 50 Hz. Best-effort, non-ARQ (§3.4 AUDIO); carried opaque like video.

csa._verify_timeout_ms: Pass 145: was 150, which a devourer craft cannot meet — its measured CSA arm time is 255-277 ms, so the ground timed out waiting for CSA_ARMED, reverted, and left the craft alone on the new channel. Must stay below rx_liveness_ms (750 default).
